verdict.rationale: Stagehand's first-party docs describe observe() as discovering actionable elements on the current page and returning structured actions that can be executed or validated before acting. That is exactly the preview-then-commit workflow in this story. Caching of observe() results reinforces that it is a distinct, reusable primitive. Missing for 10: detail on the returned action schema and how observed actions are passed to act(), plus independent or hands-on corroboration of observe-before-act use.
